column1: # One row per source file and raw call: PATH<TAB>SYMBOL<TAB>CALLS<TAB>REASON.
# CALLS lists one identity per call: a hash of the enclosing function name and
# the call's source text. The check covers non-test Go under cmd/ and internal/,
# except internal/rootio. It fails on an unlisted call and on a stale identity.
# Replace a call with the internal/rootio primitive that the failure names,
# drop its identity, and delete the row when the list is empty. A new call
# needs its identity in a row with a reason, and review of that entry.
